import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


# Version format validation and parsing
class TestVersionValidation:
    """Test version format validation."""

    def test_valid_versions(self):
        """Test that valid versions are accepted."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("10.20.30", "10.20.30")

    def test_leading_v_allowed(self):
        """Test that leading 'v' is allowed in versions."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_whitespace_trimmed(self):
        """Test that surrounding whitespace is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "  1.2.3  ")

    def test_prerelease_versions(self):
        """Test that prerelease versions are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-0.3.7", "1.2.3-0.3.7")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-x.7.z.92", "1.2.3-x.7.z.92")

    def test_build_metadata_versions(self):
        """Test that build metadata is allowed."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3+build")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+20130313144700", "1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_and_build(self):
        """Test versions with both prerelease and build."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta+build", "1.2.3-beta")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_parts(self):
        """Test that incomplete versions raise error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH raise error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_prerelease_leading_zeros(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in numeric prerelease identifiers raise error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.01", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_no_patch(self):
        """Test that versions without patch are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Test that versions with too many parts raise error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_major(self):
        """Test that non-numeric MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH raises error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_empty_prerelease(self):
        """Test that empty prerelease raises error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")


# Version comparison
class TestVersionComparison:
    """Test version ordering and comparison."""

    def test_numeric_comparison(self):
        """Test that MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.9.9")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", ">1.0.9")
        assert satisfies("1.0.1", ">1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_lower_than_release(self):
        """Test that prerelease version is lower than same version without prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_numeric_vs_text(self):
        """Test that numeric identifiers are lower than text identifiers."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-1")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_numeric_identifiers(self):
        """Test that numeric identifiers are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-2", ">1.0.0-1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-9")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_text_identifiers(self):
        """Test that text identifiers are compared in ASCII order."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-beta")

    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Test that fewer prerelease identifiers means lower version."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")

    def test_build_metadata_ignored_in_comparison(self):
        """Test that build metadata is ignored in version comparison."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build.1", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build.2", "1.2.3+build.1")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3+build.1", "1.2.3+build.2")  # build differs but should match


# Primitive comparators
class TestPrimitiveComparators:
    """Test basic comparison operators."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.3", "1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", "1.2.3", False),
            ("1.2.3", "=1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", "=1.2.3", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_exact_match(self, version, range, expected):
        """Test = and implicit = operators."""
        assert satisfies(version, range) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.2", "<1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.3", "<1.2.3", False),
            ("1.2.4", "<1.2.3", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_less_than(self, version, range, expected):
        """Test < operator."""
        assert satisfies(version, range) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.2", "<=1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.3", "<=1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", "<=1.2.3", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_less_than_or_equal(self, version, range, expected):
        """Test <= operator."""
        assert satisfies(version, range) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.2", ">1.2.3", False),
            ("1.2.3", ">1.2.3", False),
            ("1.2.4", ">1.2.3", True),
        ],
    )
    def test_greater_than(self, version, range, expected):
        """Test > operator."""
        assert satisfies(version, range) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.2", ">=1.2.3", False),
            ("1.2.3", ">=1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", ">=1.2.3", True),
        ],
    )
    def test_greater_than_or_equal(self, version, range, expected):
        """Test >= operator."""
        assert satisfies(version, range) == expected

    def test_operator_with_whitespace(self):
        """Test that whitespace after operator is allowed."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">= 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "< 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">   1.2.2")


# X-ranges and partial versions
class TestXRangesAndPartialVersions:
    """Test X-range and partial version expansion."""

    def test_star_matches_any(self):
        """Test that * matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "*")

    def test_x_matches_any(self):
        """Test that x and X match any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "X")

    def test_empty_range_matches_any(self):
        """Test that empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")

    def test_partial_version_minor_missing(self):
        """Test that 1.2 is treated as 1.2.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")

    def test_partial_version_minor_and_patch_missing(self):
        """Test that 1 is treated as 1.x.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")

    def test_x_minor_version(self):
        """Test 1.x and 1.X patterns."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1.X")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")

    def test_x_patch_version(self):
        """Test 1.2.x and 1.2.X patterns."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.X")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")

    def test_gt_partial_version(self):
        """Test >1 and >1.x patterns."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")

    def test_gt_partial_version_minor(self):
        """Test >1.2 pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", ">1.2")

    def test_gte_partial_version(self):
        """Test >=1.2 pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", ">=1.2")

    def test_lt_partial_version(self):
        """Test <1.2 pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")

    def test_lte_partial_version_major(self):
        """Test <=1 pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")

    def test_lte_partial_version_minor(self):
        """Test <=1.2 pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_gt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test that >* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", ">*")

    def test_lt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test that <* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", "<*")

    def test_invalid_gt_star(self):
        """Test that >* in a comparator raises error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">*")

    def test_invalid_lt_star(self):
        """Test that <* in a comparator raises error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", "<*")


# Tilde ranges
class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde (~) range expansion."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", True),
            ("1.2.99", True),
            ("1.3.0", False),
            ("1.1.9", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_tilde_with_all_parts(self, version, expected):
        """Test ~1.2.3 -> >=1.2.3 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies(version, "~1.2.3") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.0", True),
            ("1.2.5", True),
            ("1.3.0", False),
            ("1.1.9", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_tilde_minor_only(self, version, expected):
        """Test ~1.2 -> >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies(version, "~1.2") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("1.0.0", True),
            ("1.5.0", True),
            ("1.99.99", True),
            ("2.0.0", False),
            ("0.9.9", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_tilde_major_only(self, version, expected):
        """Test ~1 -> >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies(version, "~1") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("0.2.3", True),
            ("0.2.99", True),
            ("0.3.0", False),
            ("0.1.9", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_tilde_zero_major(self, version, expected):
        """Test ~0.2.3 -> >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies(version, "~0.2.3") == expected

    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test ~1.2.3-beta.2 -> >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.3", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0-beta.1", "~1.2.3-beta.2")

            ("1.2.4", True),
            ("1.9.9", True),
            ("2.0.0", False),

        [
            ("0.2.3", True),
            ("0.2.99", True),
            ("0.3.0", False),
            ("0.2.2", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_caret_zero_major_nonzero_minor(self, version, expected):
        """Test ^0.2.3 -> >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("0.0.3", True),
            ("0.0.3-alpha", True),
            ("0.0.4", False),
            ("0.1.0", False),

        """Test ^0.0.3 -> >=0.0.3 <0.0.4-0."""

    def test_caret_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test ^1.2.3-beta.2 -> >=1.2.3-beta.2 <2.0.0-0."""

        assert satisfies("0.0.3-gamma", "^0.0.3-beta")

            ("1.9.9", True),
            ("2.0.0", False),

        ],

    def test_caret_x_zero_zero(self, version, expected):
        """Test ^0.0.x -> >=0.0.0 <0.1.0-0."""
        assert satisfies(version, "^0.0.x") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",

            ("0.0.0", True),
            ("0.0.9", True),
            ("0.1.0", False),
        ],

    def test_caret_zero_zero_missing_patch(self, version, expected):

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",

# Comparator sets (space-separated)
class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test multiple comparators in AND logic."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",

            ("1.0.0", False),
            ("2.0.0", False),
        ],

    def test_two_comparators_and(self, version, expected):

        "version,expected",
        [
            ("1.2.3", True),
            ("1.2.4", False),
            ("1.2.2", False),
        ],
    )

    def test_x_range_as_set(self):
        """Test that X-ranges create implicit comparator sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")


# Range unions (||)
class TestRangeUnions:
    """Test multiple comparator sets with OR logic via ||."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("1.5.0", True),
            ("3.0.0", True),
            ("2.0.0", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_two_sets_or(self, version, expected):
        """Test that || creates OR logic between sets."""
        assert satisfies(version, "1.x || >=3.0.0") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,expected",
        [
            ("0.5.0", True),
            ("1.5.0", True),
            ("2.5.0", False),
        ],
    )
    def test_three_sets_or(self, version, expected):
        """Test multiple sets with OR logic."""
        assert satisfies(version, "0.x || 1.x || >=2.5.0") == expected

    def test_caret_or_tilde(self):
        """Test complex union with caret and tilde."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.3.5", "~0.2.1 || ^1.2.3")


# Prerelease matching rules
class TestPrereleaseMatching:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Test prerelease matches when comparator has prerelease with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", ">=1.2.3-alpha.1")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_different_patch(self):
        """Test prerelease doesn't match comparator with different patch."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_star(self):
        """Test prerelease doesn't match * range."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_lt(self):
        """Test prerelease doesn't match <X.Y.Z range."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_hyphen_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test prerelease matches hyphen range with prerelease bounds."""
        # 1.0.0-beta is in [1.0.0-alpha, 1.0.0]
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha - 1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_x_range_expansion(self):
        """Test that X-ranges produce -0 bounds for prerelease compatibility."""
